items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee never mentions John Chilton directly; Chilton is only cited by the interviewer as the author of a book.

ctx.x: Not too much. Because Jimmy Dorsey wasn't doing too much soloing either. You know, in his band... I think he was playing with Ben Pollack's band. He was back there in them times, '26... Because I heard him...
Yeah. He worked with Jean Goldkette and Whiteman, Vincent Lopez, Red Nichols, people like that. At least, that's according to John Chilton's book.
I think he and Benny Goodman all was with Ben Pollack at the same time.
